content: Efem biyai awi dowangua kam
Ena Yesu akai tei ma dere fu Yuria akai tei fure ena nuwi Yoran bunam koi fungoro ari munmane u moingui tei ure tokoi kuku boingoro yaromi koma mapunom dunguamere epe tokoi ka nuwi si erome.
Ena ari Feresi yokama ure “Ka kea ei towapune,” dire “Yae, yai ta efem biyai awi dowangua i faimbo?” dire ka kea ei teingoro
ena Yesu “Mose yaromi tora ka di guwo di erome?” diro mina wako erongoro
“Mose ‘Yai ta efem biyai “Awi dowaiye,” duwangua koma awi dongua munom boi tere okome awi dowangua faime,’ epe dume,” di teingoro
ena Yesu “Ne yokamai denom minom si fere de ki singa iran Mose ka i di guwo di eromba
komariki taikan muruwo bei engua kakom Yai Gumam sumuna yai te opai beme.
Yai te opai bengua iran yai nem mam ma dere fu efem biyai si daunangoro
ena surai towane morapire. Ena iran surai moikeimba surai i towane moipire.
Yai Gumam surai si dau erongua ari yokamai si guwo dikeiyo!” Yesu epe di erome.
Ena Yesu te gama yokamai fu iki ikai tokoi finga gama yokama opai awi dowangua kam Yesu mina wako teingoro
ena Yesu ka epe di erome, “Nenta efem biyai awi dere opai ta tokoi inguai yaromi yai opai kau einga bei niki dome.
Te opai ta wiyom biyai awi dere yai ta tokoi kau enguai oparomi ama epe wom yai opai kau einga bei niki dome,” di erome.
Yesu ama gaima boware guwo di erome
Ena ari yokamai gan gawo endire “Yesu okom ganomdi akoname,” dire fu moingui tei wimba Yesu gama yokamai kura kam dire “Nemane,” di ereimba

Yesu kanere niki de fire gama epe di erome, “Ari yai opai moingamere epe gan gawo morainga Yai Gumam ari kiapanom bengua akaiyom fure moraime. Ena iran ne yokamai gan gawo ‘Nemane,’ di erekeiyo! Gan gawo na moiki tei unainga faname.
Ena na ka duwaika fi goi iyo! Gan gawo Yai Gumam ari kiapanom bei erongua akai ikai nanguamere nenta epe ikai kinangua ena yaromi kakom kakom ikai kiname,” epe dire
ena gan gawo yokamai kukurere ganomdi okom akore boware guwo di erome.
Yai ta guwai gaiyom ori ako nongua “Yesu dourom boraiye,” dume

Ena okome Yesu “Man tei ma dere naiye,” dire bengoro yai ta bu di u moingui tei uro kaunom gurom boire “Ka nuwi si norenga yai yo, ne yai nokapu moine. Ena na toramere beire kakom kakom moi kuwom suwaika inaiye?” di tongoro
“Ta bengoro ne ‘Na yai nokapu moine,’ dine? Ari yai opai muruwo nokapu moikeimba Yai Gumam nen towane nokapu moime.

Ena ne Yai Gumam ka di guwo dungua epe mora finie: Ari ei goikeyo! Yai opai kau einga bei niki dekeyo! Tai koropane kunei nekeyo! Ka kasu dikeyo! Ari kanom ka sikeyo! Nenum manum bei kenom bei ero! Ka di guwo epe dume,” Yesu epe di tongoro
“Ka nuwi si norenga yai yo, ka di guwo dunguai muruwo gore di moiye. Koma na gan gawo moiro moi uka epena kakom moika na ka di guwo dungua kanom muruwo gore di moiye,” di tongoro

ena Yesu yaromi gumam kanere dem miriyom mun fi tere “Ne tai towane beikene. Ne fure guwai gainum muruwo ari erere kongo mukom ire fure ari kuwanom moinga yokamai erowanga ena ne guwai gainum kamundi iwa ako nowanie. Epe beire ena ure na dowinam boro!” di tongoro
yaromi ka i fire giram gumam yororo dume. Yaromi guwai gaiyom ori ako nongua dem miriyom ipun dongoro dere fume.
Fungoro ena Yesu awa tere kan gama yokama de erere “Ari yokamai kongo guwai gainom munmane ako neinga yokamai Yai Gumam ari kiapanom bei erongua akaiyom naro benainga i ipun dowame,” di erongoro
gama yokamai ka i fire ganom nouro dimba Yesu tokoi ka epe di erome, “Ganamao, ari yokamai Yai Gumam ari kiapanom bei erongua akaiyom naro benainga i ipun dowame.

Te non ori i kam kame bei moiro kai kun engui ikai nangua i kokonan ori dumba yai ta kongo guwai gaiyom ako nongua yaromi bei moiro Yai Gumam ari kiapanom bei erongua akaiyom ikai nangua i kokonan ori nan dume,” di erongoro
ena gama yokamai ganom nouro orinan dire “Aiya! Yai Gumam eramom akire di towangoro kakom kakom moi kuwom suwangua akaiyom iname?” di teingoro
Yesu gama ekanere “Ari nenen kounom beikeimba Yai Gumam taikan muruwo kounom beiro moime. Ena iran Yai Gumam ari akire di erowangoro kakom kakom moi kuwom suwainga akaiyom inaime,” di erome.
Ena Pita bei moiro Yesu di tome, “No yokamai taikan muruwo ma dere ne dowinum boipuna kano!” di tongoro
“O, ne kawom dine. Ena na di ereiye, ‘Yai ta fi ki si narowaro beire te gunom kam di mari duwaro bengua yaromi ikom bo auwom emerom bo kepom bo nem bo mam bo gan kui nongua bo mansinom ma dowangua

Yai Gumam yaromi tai 100 mokom bai towame. Yaromi mangi tawa morangui kakom tei ikom 100 te auwom emerom 100 te kepom 100 te mam 100 te gam 100 te mansinom 100 inamba yaromi gam kipi karangua ama iname. Te okome kamundi morangui kakom kakom moi kuwom suwangua inamie,’ epe di ereiye.
Te ari epena koma moinga yokamai munmane tokoi okome moraime. Te ari okome moinga yokamai munmane tokoi koma moraime,” Yesu epe di erome.
Yesu “Goraiye,” diro eken suraiye di mari de erome

Ena Yesu te gama yokamai Yerusarem naro beinga kon bakom tei fime. Ena Yesu koma engoro ena gama yokamai okome eingoro ganom nouro dingero te ari okomewom winga kuri fime. Ena Yesu gama yokamai okonom koro koro muruwo te kaunom surai tokoi akire fu nenen moingi tei fure tai u mari boi towangua kam di mari de erome.

“Nonon Yerusarem fupungoro yai ta na ari gaunom wam naikire fi mun ei teinga ari ori te Yura ari ka di guwo dungua nuwi si ereinga yokamai i mari de erowangoro yokamai ‘Nai goiyo!’ dire ari Yura ari moikeinga yokamai okonomdi ei erowaingoro
ena Yura ari moikeinga yokamai na kanam ka sire te wepi si narere durange naire te okome nai goraimba aro kakom suraiye nangoro na tokoi arowaiye,” epe di erome.
Yemesi te Yoane yai surai Yesu ka mina wako teipire
Ena Sepeti wam surai Yemesi te Yoane u Yesu moingui tei ure “Ka kirawa si norongua yai yo, no ne mina wako erowapuka benanga inapuiye,” di teipikoro
“Na tora bei erowaikai ne di fipire?” di erongoro
ena yai surai “Ne keranom sungua moinga kakom no surai yai ta ne okonum womdi tei ame dere morangua te no surai yai ta ne okonum korari tei ame dere morame,” di teipikoro
ena Yesu “Ne surai ka dipikai nomanenom fi kun daikepire. Na tai ipun donguai inaika te ganam kipi kaingua firaika ne surai ama epe wom firaipiro?” diro mina wako erongoro
“O, no surai mora kounom bepuiye,” dipikoro “Ne surai kawom dipire. Na tai ipun donguai inaika te ganam kipi kaingua firaika ne surai ama epe wom firaipipa
ne surai na okonam womdi bo okonam korari ame dere moraipika erowaika na moiki tei dikeme. Yai Gumam akai i kenom bengua iran ari suwo koropane erowame,” epe di erome.
Ena okome Yesu gama yokamai okonom koro koro muruwo moiro yai surai ka dipikai fire Yemesi te Yoane niki de fi ereime.

Ena Yesu gama yokamai muruwo unom boingoro wingoro “Ne yokamai mora mapunom fingai mangi ari kiapanom bei ereinga yokamai ari nuwi kokonan ereime. Te mangi ari wanopanom yokamai ari kanom iwe de erere wan moime.
Ne yokamai epe beikeiyo! Yai ta ne yokamai suna tei moingua ‘Na yai ori moraiye,’ duwangua yaromi nuwi kokonan ne yokamai bei erowame.
Te yai ta ne yokamai suna tei moingua ‘Na komawom yai moraiye,’ duwangua yaromi nuwi kokonan ari muruwo bei erowame.

Te na ari gaunom wam bei moiro ‘Ari nuwi kokonan bei narowaime,’ diro kuiye. Tamanume. Na mangi ure nuwi kokonan inaro wiye. Te na ‘Goiro ari munmane meina baikoro yokamai Yai Gumam moingui tei inako dere unaime,’ ama diro wiye,” Yesu epe di erome.
Yesu yai ta okom murom gi dungua ako fura de tome

Ena Yesu te gama yokamai iki birom ori Yeriko wime. Ena yokamai te ari munmane gere akai tei ma dowaingi Timeyu wam Batimeyuso okom murom gi dungua yaromi kon bunamdi tei ame dere ari “Tai nareiyo!” diro yana di erome.
Ena yaromi ka finguai Yesu Nasareti nem moingua ungoro yaromi “Yesu yo, ne Dawiri gauwom moine. Na kanam fi naro!” diro u boimba
ari munmane kura kam di tere “Nemane,” dire “Ka dikeo!” di teimba u ori wom boire “Dawiri gauwom yo, na kanam firo!” di tongoro
ena Yesu konmori tei ariro “Yaromi uwom boiyo!” di erongoro yokamai yai okom murom gi dungua yaromi uwom boire “Ne minum moko! Ario! Yaromi ne unum boi erome,” di teingoro
ena yaromi ka i fire suna gaiyom fia si dere si gi dire u Yesu moingui tei fume.
Fungoro ena Yesu “Na tora bei erowaika di fine?” diro mina wako tongoro “Ka kirawa si norongua yai yo, ne na okonam murom ako fura de narowane di fiye,” dungoro
“Ne na kanam fi ki si narenga iran ne okonum murom fura dome. Ena ne ikinum fo!” di tongoro ena kene kene eire okom murom fura dongoro tai kanere Yesu dourom boi fume.
